bullets.text: Russian DDoS Attacks Intensify - **NCSC** warns critical infrastructure in the UK is under persistent threat from Russian hackers.
LilaConnect's Rapid Migration - **LilaConnect** successfully migrated to **gaiia** in just 16 weeks, enhancing operational efficiency.
AI for Telecom Compliance - **IBM** and **e&** partner to enhance governance and compliance using AI technologies.
Wi-Fi 7 Set for 2026 - **Cisco** predicts 2026 will be a pivotal year for widespread **Wi-Fi 7** adoption.
Semantic Layers in Telecom - **Semantic layers** are crucial for overcoming data challenges in the telecom sector.
Ericsson's 5G-Advanced Services - **Ericsson** launches new **5G-Advanced** location services for various industries.
Telenor Exits Thailand - **Telenor** sells its stake in **True Corporation** for $3.9 billion, reducing its Asian footprint.
New Brazil-US Subsea Cable - **V.tal** announces the **Synapse** cable to enhance connectivity between Brazil and the US.
Liberty Global Eyes Three Ireland - **Liberty Global** is in talks to acquire **Three Ireland** for up to €1.5 billion.
Private 5G Security Gaps - Bridging security gaps in **Private 5G** networks is essential for enterprise protection.
